## Summary

Briefly describe the purpose of this PR. What problem does it solve?

## Changes

- Bullet the key code changes
- Keep items short and actionable

## Motivation & Context

Why is this change needed? Link to issues or relevant context.

## How Tested

- Steps taken to verify (commands, tests run, manual checks)
- Include any relevant environment details

## Screenshots / Terminal Output (optional)

If helpful, paste small screenshots or terminal snippets showing the behavior.

## Checklist

- [ ] Code is formatted and linted (pre-commit hooks pass)
- [ ] Tests pass (`go test ./...`), or reason explained
- [ ] Docs / comments updated where valuable
- [ ] Backward compatible or migration notes included
